title: Generative AI Uncovers Novel Chrebp/Txnip Axis Inhibitors with Potential Anti-inflammatory Activity.
authors: Qayyum, Naila; Khan, Abdul Waheed; Haseeb, Muhammad; Ahmed, Bilal; Farooq, Mariya; Manan, Abdul; Kim, Eunha; Choi, Sangdun
journal: Journal of chemical information and modeling
one_liner_zh: 该文用生成式AI设计小分子抑制剂靶向Chrebp/14-3-3蛋白-蛋白互作，虽涉及分子动力学模拟，但对象为蛋白-蛋白而非蛋白-DNA互作，与本课题TF-DNA体系无关。
abstract: Type 2 diabetes is driven in part by metabolic inflammation, where activation of the Chrebp/Txnip axis promotes NLRP3 inflammasome assembly, leading to pancreatic beta-cell dysfunction and pro-inflammatory cytokine release. Despite the therapeutic relevance of this pathway, the Chrebp-14-3-3 (regulatory-protein client) protein-protein interaction (PPI) remains largely underexplored, with only a limited number of small-molecule modulators reported to date. To address this gap, we developed an artificial intelligence-driven generative design framework for de novo discovery of selective PPI-targeting compounds. A conditional recurrent neural network (cRNN), implemented as a quantitative structure-property relationship-guided generative network (QSPR-GEN), was pretrained on a large, chemically diverse corpus to learn general SMILES syntax and structural priors, and subsequently fine-tuned on a curated, target-focused data set of approximately 5900 compounds, achieving high scaffold uniqueness (94.6%). Selectivity-oriented physicochemical descriptors were incorporated as conditional inputs to bias generation away from promiscuous chemotypes, while maintaining anchoring to a known active seed. Structure-based refinement was further applied by focusing on the noncanonical alpha-helical epitope unique to the Chrebp regulatory-protein interface, establishing a dual-layered strategy for selective PPI modulation. The integrated pipeline, combining virtual screening, molecular dynamics simulations, and MM/PBSA free-energy calculations, prioritized lead candidates with favorable binding energetics and pharmacokinetic profiles. In THP-1 macrophages under metabolic stress, the top candidate T7 markedly suppressed Txnip and NLRP3 expression, reduced IL-1beta secretion, and attenuated pyroptotic cell death, outperforming a reference inhibitor. Collectively, this study presents a robust computational framework for the inverse design of challenging PPIs and demonstrates its utility through the identification and experimental validation of mechanistically precise lead compounds, exemplified by T2 and T7.
abstract_zh: 2型糖尿病部分由代谢性炎症驱动，其中Chrebp/Txnip轴的激活促进NLRP3炎症小体组装，导致胰腺β细胞功能障碍和促炎细胞因子释放。尽管该通路具有治疗相关性，但Chrebp-14-3-3（调节蛋白客户）蛋白-蛋白相互作用（PPI）在很大程度上仍未得到充分探索，迄今为止仅有有限数量的小分子调节剂被报道。为弥补这一空白，我们开发了一种人工智能驱动的生成设计框架，用于从头发现选择性靶向PPI的化合物。一个条件循环神经网络（cRNN），实现为定量结构-性质关系引导的生成网络（QSPR-GEN），在大型化学多样性语料库上进行了预训练，以学习通用SMILES语法和结构先验，随后在约5900种化合物的精选靶标聚焦数据集上进行了微调，实现了高骨架独特性（94.6%）。选择性导向的物理化学描述符被纳入作为条件输入，以偏置生成远离泛活性化学型，同时保持锚定于已知活性种子。进一步应用基于结构的细化，聚焦于Chrebp调节蛋白界面特有的非经典α-螺旋表位，建立了选择性PPI调节的双层策略。整合流程结合虚拟筛选、分子动力学 (molecular dynamics) 模拟和MM/PBSA自由能计算，优先筛选出具有有利结合能学和药代动力学特征的先导候选物。在代谢应激下的THP-1巨噬细胞中，顶级候选物T7显著抑制了Txnip和NLRP3表达，减少了IL-1β分泌，并减弱了焦亡细胞死亡，优于参考抑制剂。总体而言，本研究为挑战性PPI的逆向设计提供了一个稳健的计算框架，并通过识别和实验验证机制精确的先导化合物（以T2和T7为例）展示了其实用性。
